cipher.summary: Fixed a config-mutation leak in RateLimitConfigSeam's mock, a cross-policy window-state bug in RateLimitSeam, a circuit-breaker success recorded before the response body was read in the live chat-completion path, and two tautological/broken test assertions across PR #202's and PR #204's remaining unaddressed review threads.
cipher.risks: No live-traffic validation of the deferred-breaker-success fix (no XAI_API_KEY in this environment); the RateLimitSeam cross-policy fix is currently unexercised in production since all routes share one global config; several ambiguous-value-judgment threads were deliberately left unchanged (documented above) and may warrant a human revisit.
